title: Acting as agent: VAT for your clients

scenes.caption: Your VAT clients, under agent authorisation
scenes.voice: As the client's agent, Ade sees every VAT client the practice is authorised for.

scenes.action: Open Corner Cup Café; registration and return
scenes.caption: Corner Cup Café: one quarter ready
scenes.voice: Ellie's café is VAT-registered on the standard scheme, filing quarterly.

scenes.action: Code your VAT: lines with codes; Still to code
scenes.caption: Every bank line gets a VAT treatment
scenes.voice: Every bank line has a VAT code. The AI suggests codes; it never works out the figures.

scenes.action: Return panel: Sales (net), Purchases (net), VAT on sales, VAT on purchases
scenes.caption: The nine boxes, from coded lines
scenes.voice: The nine boxes are worked out by a rules engine from the coded lines.

target.text: Worked out from your coded lines — never by the AI.

scenes.caption: Filed through Making Tax Digital (HMRC sandbox in this demo)
scenes.voice: Ade files it through Making Tax Digital. In this demo, that's HMRC's test service.

scenes.caption: Next client
scenes.voice: And on to the next client.
